subject.title: model-selection: duplicate model aliases silently overwrite each other

question: Should duplicate configured model aliases preserve the shipped last-match selected provider/model while warning, or may OpenClaw intentionally switch duplicate aliases to first-match selection?
rationale: The warning is straightforward, but changing which duplicate alias wins can change provider/model routing for existing configs and needs explicit maintainer compatibility intent.

options.title: Preserve Shipped Winner While Warning
options.body: Keep the current last matching provider/model selected, emit an operator warning for duplicates, and cover both resolver paths.

options.title: Approve First-Match Precedence
options.body: Accept the compatibility break only with upgrade proof, tests, and release-note context explaining possible provider/model rerouting.

options.title: Pause For A Unified Replacement
options.body: Use one canonical fix PR that handles both open candidate branches' concerns instead of landing a partial path.

recommendation.title: Preserve Shipped Winner While Warning
recommendation.body: Keep the current last matching provider/model selected, emit an operator warning for duplicates, and cover both resolver paths.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history owner for model aliases and the shared model-selection helper boundary.
